'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Seth Acree DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Seth Acree]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' sjacree
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
